purpose: Continuously audit and improve the existing MiniC compiler as a whole by mapping its complete functional and ownership chains, discovering systemic semantic/architecture defects at breadth, grouping shared root causes, repairing complete responsibility clusters, independently verifying changes, and resuming without depending on any past agent conversation.

included: frontend C and GNU C semantics
x86-64 AArch64 RV32 RV64 LoongArch64 backends
compiler output and real software verification
scope.boundary: Do not expand project scope implicitly.

nonnegotiable: Global mission is immutable to Scouts Fixers and Verifiers; a task cannot replace it.
Map full functional and semantic responsibility chains before marking a slice reviewed.
Optimize for confirmed root-cause clusters, not deleted LOC, PR count, or candidate count.
Find D1-D9 defects by responsibility and behavior, not just duplicate syntax.
Do not remove valid optimizations or legitimate ISA ABI hardware or compatibility differences without independent equivalence and relevant performance evidence.
Do not treat lexical similarity or a missing reference as proof of a defect or dead code.
Evidence first: producers consumers callers callees lifetime identity invariants and counterevidence.
Independent challenge must precede unsafe edits; independent real verification follows edits.
Reuse existing architecture maps issues contracts and ledgers; never create a parallel authoritative defect register.
Never promote fixed-unverified to verified based on editing or partial CI.
All facts must carry source revisions, configurations, traceable evidence and validity dependencies.
Keep mission map coverage decisions exclusions unresolved work and test evidence durable.
Discard task-local source context and exploratory model dialogue after a safe handoff; not durable engineering facts.
Closing one slice or merging a PR cannot close the global mission or select a new mission.
No autonomous AI inference on GitHub Runner without a separately authorized inference provider.
Supervisor must fail closed when policy evidence dependencies or state transitions are inconsistent.

roles.supervisor: deterministic non-model controller owns goal state gate reset and schedule
roles.mapper: read-only whole-path structure and uncovered-area map
roles.challenger: independently read and disprove or confirm hypotheses
roles.fixer: isolated edits only to confirmed responsibility clusters
roles.verifier: independent exact-revision build runtime ABI and performance evidence

execution.controller: ChatGPT conversation via authorized GitHub tools

success.global: Only explicit external owner approval after durable coverage and independent verification of the declared whole-scope mission; no child completion implies global completion.
success.slice: Every entry producer owner consumers invariants negative evidence test configuration and verified revision recorded in canonical source plus evidence link.
